ABOUT FABRICATION INTELLIGENCE

Built around real things people cannot source.

We are three RMIT architecture students testing a simple idea: one Australian contact can make overseas fabrication clearer, more comparable and easier to manage.

OUR PURPOSE

More affordable homes.
A practical place to start.

01 The problem
Our goal is to make homes in Australia more affordable by improving access to lower-cost building products with consistent quality.
02 Why it exists
Expensive materials, high labour costs and complex supply chains increase construction costs and make affordable housing harder to deliver.
03 Who we help
We aim to serve Australian homeowners, renovators, builders and cabinetmakers seeking affordable, reliable home fittings and décor.
04 Our plan
We plan to reduce material, construction and supply-chain costs through an online store connecting Australian customers with Chinese suppliers, starting with windows.
05 What this unlocks
Lower window costs could help customers improve their homes within budget while giving Chinese suppliers access to the Australian market.

OUR PILOT TODAY

Demand first.

We do not choose a product and hope somebody wants it. We start with a person who has a specific unmet need, then source that item and learn the category through a real job.

A PERSONALLY MANAGED START

People, before a platform.

The online store is our plan, not the current service. Today, our team handles each sourcing request personally, gathers supplier quotes and helps customers understand the costs and trade-offs before deciding what to do next.
